# Solitaire card illustration prompts

Built-in image_gen tool, transparent backgrounds. Final assets are in dist/solitaire/assets. Prior unused KT drafts are outside the repository.

## KT

Create one NEW KT Wiz royal card sprite strip in a cohesive set of THREE portraits. Input 1 (new Queen Ddory) is the APPROVED MASCOT IDENTITY AND SHAPE, input 2 (KT original Vic and Ddory) locks exact original character anatomy and face, input 3 (Samsung royal strip) is the RENDERING/PAINTING STYLE to match. Output a real transparent 3:1 horizontal sprite, three equal square cells, isolated full bodies, same centered scale and baseline, generous clear margin, no overlapping between cells. LEFT JACK = white DDORY in page cap with feather and red/black/gold page tunic, holding bat. MIDDLE QUEEN = the EXACT recognizable white DDORY from input 1, keep elongated integrated head-and-body, enormous tall open black mouth, two small upper teeth, small black circular eye on viewer left and red diamond eye on viewer right; black pointy wizard hat with queen tiara, red/gold cape and white/red royal tunic, tiny baseball scepter, joyful raised arm. RIGHT KING = black VIC with long RED EYEBROWS and original white crescent eyes and red-edged wide grin, pointy black hat under gold crown, black/red/gold cape and bat scepter. For BOTH WHITE DDORY J and Q: NO CAT EARS, NO SEPARATE ANIMAL HEAD, NO SNOUT, NO FURRY ROUND CAT SHAPE, NO HUMAN WAIST, no eyelashes; original long big-mouth monster silhouette as approved, original limbs with red fingertip pads. Jack should also have original black circle + red diamond eyes. For Vic preserve original monster face, do not invent eye shapes. STYLE: match Samsung reference's polished cute chibi 2D illustration, warm restrained soft highlights and shading, gold edges, crisp clean dark outlines, tasteful royal outfit details. This is a style refinement with ORIGINAL KT ANATOMY locked; make all three read as part of same Samsung/KIA/LG card illustration set, no flat simplistic vector look, no gritty realism. Keep whimsical proportions and original expressive mouth. All feet/hats/crowns/props fully fit within their individual cell, no card frames, no text, no letters, no suit symbols, no watermark. Design legible when shrunk on mobile.

## Samsung

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent horizontal sprite strip for a Korean baseball-community Klondike solitaire game. Create exactly THREE separate cute chibi mascot portraits, left-to-right JACK, QUEEN, KING, in three equal square cells in ONE 3:1 horizontal image. Each character centered in its own square, with generous transparent margins, identical scale and baseline, NO cell lines, NO card frames, NO text, NO lettering, NO suit symbols. Soft clean polished 2D digital illustration, bold readable silhouette, cozy simplified details visible on a tiny mobile playing card. Jack wears a jaunty page cap and holds a tiny baseball bat; queen wears a small elegant gold tiara, cape and holds a baseball flower; king wears a gold royal crown and holds a bat-shaped scepter. Keep the exact mascot facial identity from the reference and recognizable team colors, add costume only. White/transparent background with real alpha, no scenery. Compose for each cell to be displayed separately with CSS background-position. All three figures completely isolated, no overlap.
Reference image identifies Samsung Lions Bleo family. Jack is cute little blue-uniform Laon with golden tuft, Queen is female golden-maned Lenny/Pinkle-like lion in royal blue and gold with big kind eyes, King is Bleo blue-cap golden-maned lion. Preserve recognizable lion ears, round faces and blue-team clothing.
